security_recall_007.answer: yes. Recall period: 2 years. Order: Inverse order of placement on layoff. Notice method: Phone call, then certified letter if unreachable. Response deadline: End of next business day (phone) / 7 days postmark (letter). Benefit restoration: Retains seniority numbers, accumulated sick leave, salary schedule placement rights, and all other rights.
security_recall_007.evidence: A teacher placed on layoff shall have rights to reinstatement for a period of two (2) years... Reinstatement must be in the inverse order of placement on lay off... District shall notify qualified teachers of the availability of a position by first calling the teacher... If the teacher is not reached by phone, a certified letter... shall be sent... Within seven (7) days of the date of postmark... Teachers recalled to duty shall retain their seniority numbers, accumulated sick leave, salary schedule placement rights, and all other rights.

security_rif_criterion_008.evidence: district-wide seniority shall continue to be the only basis for determining the number of teachers who must be laid off due to staff reductions. ... Tenured teachers shall be placed on layoff in inverse order of seniority

security_probation_length_009.evidence: first create an opening from probationary or non-tenured teachers in their first three years

security_tenure_rules_010.evidence: A teacher is considered tenured when meeting the requirements in Minnesota Statutes § 122A.41... successfully completes the contractual Achievement of Tenure process... Tenured teachers shall be placed on layoff in inverse order of seniority.

security_certification_011.answer: discussed_unclear. Licensure areas and filing deadlines are referenced for layoff purposes, but specific renewal or endorsement requirements are not detailed in this section.
security_certification_011.evidence: only those teaching licenses that are filed and/or posted on the Teacher Licensing Board website by March 1 of that year will be considered for purposes of determining layoffs within areas of licensure.
